_doc: Revert-verify mutants for vault-exodev ems__Bug 151b98a1, subject AggregateTranslator.ts: the HAVING / SELECT-expression operator table (`transformExpressionWithAggregateVars`) dispatches unary minus / plus to the shared helper with the ALREADY-TRANSFORMED operand (aggregate sub-expressions replaced by their variables). Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect`. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders. The harness also runs the compliance test "should support unary negation" (un-skipped by the fix); W-mutants are plausible WRONG implementations from the independent review of the spec — each must turn exactly its review axis (A18–A24) red.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/infrastructure/sparql/algebra/AggregateTranslator.ts

M7_aggregate_table_skips_unary._note: The groomer's measured case: only the expression table is fixed — HAVING and SELECT expressions stay broken. Review axes: A19/A22/A23/A24 are the SECOND-table parity axes; the compliance test is a SELECT expression.

M8_raw_operand._note: Plausible wrong implementation: the operand is re-translated from the raw AST instead of taken from `transformedArgs`, so an aggregate under the sign is not replaced by its variable. Review axes: `+SAMPLE(?l)` in HAVING: the raw operand keeps the aggregate untranslated, the ASK fails instead of false.

M9_sign_only_over_a_bare_aggregate._note: Independent review of the plan, W1 — a plausible wrong second table: the sign is handled only when its operand IS an aggregate; any other operand goes to the expression table, which does not know the aggregate variables (`-(SUM(?o) + 1)`, `-(-COUNT(*))` fail with «Unsupported expression structure»). Shares its anchor with M8 — the driver applies every mutant to a clean copy.
M9_sign_only_over_a_bare_aggregate.to:
if (aggregateVarMap.has(opExpr.args[0] as SparqljsExpression)) return unaryToArithmetic(unaryOperator, transformedArgs[0]);
        return this.translateExpressionFn(expr);

W1_AT_double_negation._note: Plausible wrong fold: a nested minus `-(-X)` returns X untouched. Numeric axes (A2 `-(-?o) = ?o`) stay green; on a non-numeric X SPARQL says type error, `0 - (0 - X)` gives it, the fold returns X bound.

W2_AT_minus_over_subtraction_swaps._note: Plausible wrong rewrite: `-(A - B)` → `(B - A)`. Equal on numbers; on date − date the swapped subtraction is a duration (-P9D), while `0 - (date - date)` is an error.

W3_AT_plus_over_arithmetic_is_identity._note: Plausible wrong shortcut: `+` over arithmetic returns the arithmetic itself. Equal on numbers; on a date/duration result `0 + D` is an error, the shortcut returns D.
W3_AT_plus_over_arithmetic_is_identity.to:
if (unaryOperator === "+" && transformedArgs[0].type === "arithmetic") return transformedArgs[0];
        return unaryToArithmetic(unaryOperator, transformedArgs[0]);

W4_AT_plus_identity_except_aggregate._note: The alternative the plan rejected: `+A` returns A unless A is an aggregate. C4 locks it for the FIRST table only; A24 is C4 + A13 for the second (`+?l` must stay unbound), A23 the composite case.
W4_AT_plus_identity_except_aggregate.to:
if (unaryOperator === "+" && !aggregateVarMap.has(opExpr.args[0] as SparqljsExpression)) return transformedArgs[0];
        return unaryToArithmetic(unaryOperator, transformedArgs[0]);
